title: Open direct-image comparison intertwines pinned counits
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $V\subset Y$ open, $U=f^{-1}V$, $f_0:U\to V$ its restriction, and $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $R_X,R_Y$ be exact derived open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], $b_f:Rf_*\mathbin{\star}R_Y\cong R_X\mathbin{\star}Rf_{0*}$ the fixed sectionwise-derived comparison [def-pc-n3-open-base-change-comparisons], and $d_f:R_Y\mathbin{\star}Lf_0^*\cong Lf^*\mathbin{\star}R_X$ the constructed open pullback square [def-pc-t2-open-pullback-square-iso], where the star denotes functor sequencing (left factor first). For the adjunctions pinned to the left-derived composition counits [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], $Lf_0^*(b_f(K))\gg\epsilon_{f_0}(R_XK)=d_f(Rf_*K)\gg R_X(\epsilon_f(K))$. There is no base-change square or comparison of base-change arrows in this assertion.

proof.text: Compute the explicit direct-image comparison on a K-injective representative. Exact restriction preserves K-injectives; the underived comparison is the sectionwise identity on inverse-image opens. Under the pinned tensor adjunction, both counit composites evaluate the same restricted tensor on sections.

Use the left and right derived factorization identities to descend this equation. The open pullback square is built from the same derived composition counits, and exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction pins the adjunction to them and the recorded right-derived units. Therefore the descended equation is the displayed equality. All identities are natural, so zero coefficients and empty opens are included.
